name: agent-flow
description: A live workflow panel: the main model, the advisor and every spawned agent as cards joined by arrows

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: batch-and-errors: a toast when an agent fails or is refused, and when every running agent has ended. every-agent: also one per finished agent. errors: failures and refusals only. off: none.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a short tone with notifications: a rising ding when a batch ends, a low tone on a failure or refusal (macOS).
